name: Otona no Hatsukoi, Hajimemasu
original_name: 大人の初恋、はじめます
source:
"From now on, we’re more than friends."

Even as an adult, the memory of your first love has remained in your heart. After a fateful reunion with him, you gather your courage and reveal your true feelings, but he turns you down.
Luckily 5 of your childhood friends are there to help mend your broken heart.
But then one day...you cross the line of friendship...?!
“Forget about that guy already.”

For the longest time, you only ever thought of him as a friend. But one day, you suddenly find yourself attracted to him...?! 
You’ve been best friends since you were kids, but seeing him now makes your heart race!
Are you the only one too embarrassed to make eye contact? But then...

“You’ve become so beautiful.”

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.htkoi.en&hl=es]Official English description[/url]]
translation:
“从现在开始，我们不仅仅是朋友了。”

即使成年了，初恋的记忆仍然留在你的心里。与他命运般的重逢后，你鼓起勇气，表露了自己的真实感受，但他拒绝了你。
幸运的是，你的5位儿时好友可以帮助你治愈受伤的心。
但有一天……你跨越了友谊的界限……？！
“已经忘记那个家伙了。”

很长一段时间，你只把他当作朋友。但有一天，你突然发现自己被他吸引了……？！
你们从小就是最好的朋友，但现在看到他会让你心跳加速！
你是唯一一个因为尴尬而不敢进行目光接触的人吗？但后来…

“你变得这么漂亮了。”
